text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry...! I didn't mean to make you 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, it's really not a big deal. 
I'm sure if I rest just a bit, I'll be 
able to move right away!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
If there's one thing I'm confident in, 
it's my durability!
choice_data_list:
Just to be safe, let's get some rest for 
now.
Let's train within reason, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-But really—
choice_data_list:
Let's wait until you're fully recovered 
before training.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I-I understand......

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed, one injury can easily lead to 
another, after all."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then I have to heal up with everything 
I've got first. With everything... with 
all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Good night!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black headed back to the dorms 
with a determined look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yay! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, nice and easy, nice and 
easy...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Slowly, slowly...! ...Huh? Was my form 
supposed to look like this?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Was it lifting my legs higher? Or my arms? 
It gets so confusing trying to run while 
protecting my injury. Umm, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crack)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Gahhh!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Whoops... I think I might've messed up...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right, nice and easy, nice and 
easy...!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm heading off!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...! Yeah, feeling good!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were no particular issues after 
that... and she was able to resume her 
usual training right away.
